_comment: Copy this to alm_config.json and fill it in. NO CREDENTIALS IN HERE: set ALM_USER and ALM_PASSWORD (or ALM_CLIENT_ID and ALM_API_KEY_SECRET) in the environment instead. alm_config.json is never committed.
_customer_id_note: ALM SaaS only (a *.saas.microfocus.com server). Leave it out for on-premises. Your site administrator has the value; the reference calls it customer-id.
